headline: Quiet streak continues as earlier boosts wear off
body: Another day without scored news. Earlier announcements continued to fade, shaving about 0.02 off Protector God, Gatekeeper and the endings that need powerful AI, while the world factors drifted by hundredths. Without fresh news, the slow fading of older stories is the only thing moving the lines. Horizon Balance edged to +2.11.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Gatekeeper -0.02.
